lesson.question: How should returned research update current memory without importing unsupported facts or erasing failed experiments?
lesson.inputs: Sixteen exact report files and the current UAI/contract/history routes.
lesson.method: Review by topic, verify selected primary-source corrections, distribute guidance, separate proposals, preserve raw identities and old receipts, and update routing validators.
lesson.result: Current guidance points to the September review; every report has a disposition and concrete memory use; historical evidence remains independently checked.
lesson.uncertainty: Research cannot establish local inference, candidate licensing/quality, hardware limits or current hosting; blocked source scanning remains explicit.
lesson.decision: Use source-first quality screening, separate semantic/numerical/browser evidence and capability-based seed/release planning before selecting major replacements.
lesson.reusable_lesson: Update current routing and checks together; preserve historical facts and hashed authority blocks, and do not call examples or repeated advisory consensus implementation evidence.
